text:
Olivia: Hey finance 1. Bought rail tickets for a small customer workshop in Amsterdam yesterday. Corporate card was declined by the operator's site so I used my personal card to complete a multi-pass booking for 4 people. Need to split cost across two projects and reimburse me. Booking ref: RAIL-APX-778. Total charged: 
c256.40 EUR (no separate VAT line on e-ticket PDF). Receipt: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/rail_apx_0326.pdf

Ravi: Can you list the 4 travelers and which project each should be charged to? Also confirm whether any were contractors/clients so we code appropriately.

Olivia: Travelers: Olivia Park (Redwood) - PROJ-84, Diego Ramos (Redwood) - PROJ-84, Mei Chen (Contractor, SOW-312) - charge to contractor reimbursement, and Lars Bek (Acme client) - client will be invoiced later (billable).

Hannah: Quick policy note : multi-pass public transport booked for mixed groups must have (1) passenger list, (2) allocation amounts or percentages, (3) proof of payment and (4) vendor invoice if reclaiming VAT. E-ticket PDFs often don't show VAT; we need vendor invoice or contact for VAT reg no.

finance-bot: Automated checklist: required for multi-pass train bookings -> original e-ticket, passenger list, allocation mapping, proof of payment (card stmt), vendor booking confirmation with supplier VAT reg number for VAT reclaim. If vendor cannot provide VAT invoice, classify as non-reclaimable.

Olivia: Attached e-ticket and my personal card statement snippet showing the 
c256.40 charge: https://files.redwood.example/outbox/personal_card_tx_2075123456.png I propose splitting costs: two passengers to PROJ-84 (each 
c64.10), contractor reimbursed 
c64.10 to Evan Park (contractor), and client portion 
c64.10 marked billable to Acme PO (Sales will invoice). That adds up to 
c256.40. No FX fees (EUR).

Ravi: Allocation looks fine. For the contractor, AP needs proof of payment by contractor (they paid on the group booking?), or do we reimburse contractor for their share? Clarify.

Olivia: Mei was included in the group booking but I paid for all on personal card. She agrees to be reimbursed. I have her confirmation email and her contractor vendor profile: https://vendor.redwood.example/mei_chen/profile

Hannah: Good. For client billing, Sales needs a quick confirmation email from Acme that they expect to be invoiced. @Procurement / @Ravi, does finance want Sales to add PO/PO number on the invoice later?

Procurement: Sales should provide PO if they want direct billing. For now tag the client portion as "billable - pending PO" and include Acme contact. If PO arrives later we will move to billable AR.

finance-bot: Note: If vendor (rail operator) supplies an invoice with VAT reg number we will attempt VAT reclaim. Many national rail operators treat fares as exempt or have specific rules; expect low likelihood of VAT reclaim. AP will check once vendor reply received.

Ravi: Olivia, please do the following in the expense portal:
- Create 4 expense lines reflecting allocations:
  * Olivia Park 
c64.10 
c64.10 paid personal card -> GL 6102 -> PROJ-84 -> reimbursable
  * Diego Ramos 
c64.10 -> PROJ-84 (charge to corporate) OR if you prefer, list as part of your reimbursement allocation
  * Mei Chen (contractor) 
c64.10 -> create AP vendor "Mei Chen (contractor)" with proof of payment and SOW -> code GL 7005 contractor reimbursables
  * Acme client portion 
c64.10 -> expense type "Billable client expense" -> tag "billable-pending-PO" and include Acme contact email
- Attach e-ticket PDF, personal card tx screenshot, and Mei's confirmation email.

Olivia: Done - submitted at https://expenses.redwood.example/submit/2075123456 and attached everything including Mei's note confirming reimbursement. Also emailed the rail operator support requesting an itemized invoice and VAT reg no: support@eu-rail.example (ticket #EU-9981).

Procurement: Good. If vendor can't provide VAT invoice, code any reclaim attempt to GL 6550 (non-reclaimable travel). Ravi, please flag contractor reimbursement for AP verification of vendor invoice vs contractor claim.

Hannah: Two more items: (1) since you used personal card due to a corpcard decline, file a card-decline report at https://travel.redwood.example/decline-report so Procurement can track operator acceptance issues; (2) if Sales later can't invoice Acme, the client portion should be escalated to Sales for approval to absorb or write-off.

Olivia: Filed decline report (ref DR-207512) and added Sales contact alex.sales@acme.example to the expense notes. Thanks all :thumbsup:

finance-bot: Thread summary: allocations recorded -> expense submitted with attachments -> AP to verify contractor docs -> awaiting vendor invoice for VAT reclaim -> card-decline report filed -> thread closed by finance-bot.
